title: Choosing where to run: a placement guide

kcs.statement: For a latency requirement, choose the Region closest to users, add edge locations for cacheable content, and use Local Zones or Wavelength only when single-digit-millisecond latency is required.
For an availability requirement, spread resources across Availability Zones; add a second Region only when the requirement names a regional disaster or global users.
Global infrastructure lets a company launch in a new country in minutes by choosing an existing Region instead of building a data center, which is the speed-of-deployment and global-reach benefit.
